records.headline: How the X200 cleans the air
records.description: Inside the X200: the airflow, the two-layer filter, the particle sensor and Auto mode.
records.articleSection:
Technical Article raw text: TECHNICAL ARTICLE
Inside the X200: the airflow, the two-layer filter, the particle sensor and Auto mode.

Airflow

The X200's fan sits above the filter and pulls air in through the slots on all four sides of the casing. Drawing from every side means you can stand it near a wall, as long as you leave 30 cm of space.

At its top speed the X200 delivers 210 m³ of clean air an hour. That changes the air in a 25 m² room with a 2.4 m ceiling about three and a half times an hour.

The filter

The X200-F is a round, two-layer filter. The outer layer is H13 HEPA: pleated glass-fiber media that captures 99.95% of particles down to 0.3 microns. The inner layer is granulated activated carbon, which adsorbs cooking smells and some volatile organic compounds.

Particles build up on the HEPA layer and the carbon slowly fills, so the filter can't be cleaned and reused. A fine mesh pre-filter on the outside catches hair and large dust.

The sensor and Auto mode

A laser particle sensor near the base counts particles in the incoming air every 2 seconds. The light ring turns blue, amber or red from that count.

In Auto mode the X200 picks a fan speed from the same count. It steps up one speed at a time and waits 30 seconds before stepping down again, so the fan doesn't hunt.

Noise

Noise was measured at 1 m in a quiet room: 24 dB on Sleep, 38 dB on speed 2 and 52 dB on Turbo. Sleep mode also dims the light ring.

records.name: How to replace the X200 filter

step.name: Switch off and unplug
step.text: Switch the X200 off and unplug it from the wall.

step.name: Open the back panel
step.text: Turn the purifier round. Press the two tabs at the bottom of the back panel and lift the panel away.

step.name: Take out the old filter
step.text: Pull the old filter out by its fabric tab. Put it in the bag your new filter came in, so the dust stays inside.

step.name: Unwrap the new filter
step.text: Remove all the plastic wrapping from the new X200-F filter.

step.name: Fit the new filter
step.text: Slide the new filter in with the fabric tab facing you, until it sits flat against the back of the housing.

step.name: Close the panel and reset the light
step.text: Hook the top of the back panel on, press it shut until both tabs click, plug the purifier in, and hold the Filter button for 5 seconds.

mainEntity.name: How often should I replace the X200 filter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every 6 months in normal use, or sooner if the filter light turns red. In a home with pets or smokers, check it every 4 months. The X200 Pro's filter lasts 12 months.

mainEntity.name: Can I wash the filter?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The X200-F filter can't be washed or rinsed, because water damages the HEPA layer and the carbon. You can vacuum the outer pre-filter mesh gently once a month to keep dust off it.

mainEntity.name: Which filter does the X200 use?

acceptedAnswer.text: The X200 uses the X200-F, an H13 HEPA filter with an activated carbon layer. The X200 Pro uses the X200P-F. The two filters are different sizes and don't fit each other's purifier.

mainEntity.name: Where can I buy replacement filters?

acceptedAnswer.text: From our online shop, or from the stockists on our Where to buy page. The X200-F costs £29 and the X200P-F costs £39.

mainEntity.name: How do I reset the filter light?

acceptedAnswer.text: After fitting a new filter, hold the Filter button for 5 seconds until the light goes out. Our guide How to reset the X200 filter light has the full steps.

mainEntity.name: Why does my new filter smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new carbon layer can give off a faint smell for the first 2 to 3 days. It's harmless and fades on its own. Running the purifier on speed 3 by an open window helps it pass sooner.

mainEntity.name: How loud is the X200?

acceptedAnswer.text: The X200 runs at 24 dB on Sleep, 38 dB on speed 2 and 52 dB on Turbo. Sleep is about as loud as rustling leaves; Turbo is about as loud as a quiet conversation.

mainEntity.name: What size room is the X200 for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rooms up to 25 m². For larger rooms, or open-plan spaces up to 45 m², choose the X200 Pro.

mainEntity.name: Can I control the X200 from my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The X200 has no Wi-Fi. You control it from the buttons on its top panel or with the remote in the box.

mainEntity.name: Can I control the X200 Pro from my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Install the Ridgeline Home app (iOS 16 or later, Android 11 or later) and connect the X200 Pro to a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network. Our guide How to connect the X200 Pro to Wi-Fi walks you through it.

mainEntity.name: What do the colors of the light ring mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: They show what the particle sensor reads. Blue means the air is clean, amber means it's fair, and red means it's poor. In Auto mode, the fan speeds up when the ring turns amber or red.

mainEntity.name: How much power does the X200 use?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3 W on Sleep and 45 W on Turbo. It runs on 220–240 V AC mains power.

mainEntity.name: Can the X200 help with asthma or allergies?

acceptedAnswer.text: The X200's H13 filter captures 99.95% of airborne particles down to 0.3 microns, including pollen, dust and pet dander. It isn't a medical device and hasn't been tested to treat or prevent asthma, allergies or any other condition. If you have symptoms, talk to your doctor.

mainEntity.name: Does the X200 produce ozone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The X200 and X200 Pro have no ionizer and no UV lamp, so they produce no ozone.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to leave the X200 running overnight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It's designed to run all day and all night. Keep it at least 30 cm from walls and curtains, and never cover the air outlet on top.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my purifier smells of burning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switch it off at the wall and unplug it straight away. Don't use it again. Contact us with your order number and we'll arrange a replacement.

mainEntity.name: What does the warranty cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: The X200 and X200 Pro come with a 2-year warranty from the date of delivery. It covers faults in materials and workmanship, including the fan motor, the control board and the sensor. It doesn't cover filters, which wear out with use, or damage from drops, liquids or repairs we didn't make.

mainEntity.name: How do I make a warranty claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email our support team from the contact page with your order number and a short description of the fault. We may ask for a photo or a short video. If we can't fix it, we'll replace it.

mainEntity.name: How long does delivery take?

acceptedAnswer.text: 2 to 4 working days after dispatch. Orders placed before 1 pm on a working day are dispatched the same day.

mainEntity.name: Can I return my purifier?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, within 30 days of delivery, for a full refund. Pack it in its original box, with the filter still in its wrapper if you haven't used it.
